Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. top_papers.title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
top_papers.abstract: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.25199）：Lean Pool 是 AI agents 维护和优化（grow, maintain, optimize）的 formalized mathematics 仓库——AI agents 是 first-class maintainer。这是 ai-agent × data-engineering 的方法学资产：长尾保存——为团队日后做'AI 维护大型知识/代码基础设施'提供工程模板（不只 AI 写代码，AI 维护、修订、优化大型 formal math corpus）。代码/benchmark/项目页：项目本身（Lean Pool）是公开仓库，但论文是否披露 agent loop / 维护协议仍需打开 PDF 核验。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片。
